messages:
maria: Heads-up: console prefetch credits vs econ attribution are diverging (~18%) for /chat/stream. Anyone seen this?
aj: Where are you measuring the delta? route-level or tenant-level?
maria: Route-level. Console shows ~40k prefetch credits yesterday, econ attributed ~33k.
lee: Sounds like a telemetry join miss. Econ joins on hashed(route_tag)+tenant. If exporter dropped route_tag for warmup flows, econ under-attributes.
sofia: We toggled off the routing header for warmup to cut header size. That would explain it.
aj: Quick mitigation ideas?
lee: 1) Re-enable exporting route_tag for prefetch flows (preferably hashed). 2) Add fallback join in econ by (req_id, tenant_id) with a low-confidence flag. 3) Add a console diff panel and alert when delta >5%.
sofia: I can open a small PR to the proxy to set X-Routing-Meta for prefetch and hash route_tag before export.
maria: Please do. Also ops-analytics needs a diff panel: console_prefetch_count - econ_prefetch_count by route, with sampling_rate annotation.
aj: I'll write the alert runbook and coordinate dashboard ownership.
lee: For the ETL fallback join, include service_id to reduce false matches and emit econ.join.fallback metric. Tag attribution_confidence=low.
sofia: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/proxy/+/2390  sets header + hash.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: proxy sha=b7c3 -> canary-1 (10%)
maria: Plan: sofia deploy, lee ETL change later today, aj dashboard once metric available. Re-check delta after both. :thumbsup:
